LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.Autopilot.Engage.Label: Engage target
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.Autopilot.Engage.Desc: Order {0} to attack a chosen target. {0} will move to the target and attack it under the assigned combat policy, fighting off enemies that attack along the way.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.Autopilot.Patrol.Label: Patrol: {0}
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.Autopilot.Patrol.Desc: Order {0} to walk around the chosen area, stopping to fight any enemy that comes into range.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.Autopilot.SeekDestroy.Des: {0} will chase down enemies instead of holding position. Marked and ordered targets come first.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.Autopilot.HuntAnimals.Des: {0} will hunt wild animals while drafted. Enemies always come first. {0}'s hunting policy decides which animals may be hunted.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.Autopilot.AutocastAll.Des: Mark all of {0}'s abilities for automatic casting while drafted. Single abilities can be marked or unmarked from their own menus.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.Autopilot.Pause.Label: Pause combat autopilot
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.Autopilot.Pause.Desc: Stop all automatic combat behavior for {0} and take back full control. Policies and orders are kept, but nothing acts on them until this is unchecked. Giving a fresh engage or patrol order also resumes.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.Autopilot.TakeCover.Label: Take cover
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.Autopilot.TakeCover.Desc: Ranged fighters move to firing positions with cover. Melee fighters ignore this.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.Autopilot.MeleeCharge.Des: Melee fighters charge distant targets. When off, they only attack enemies that come close.
Search and destroy picks targets from the whole map and chases them however far they run. When off, only nearby enemies the pawn can see are picked. Does nothing while search and destroy is off.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.Autopilot.FightAsSquad.De: Coordinate with nearby drafted pawns whose policy also fights as a squad: spread fire across the enemy group instead of piling onto one target, and keep one tile apart so stray shots and blasts catch one pawn, not a huddle.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.Autopilot.BashDoors.Label: Bash doors
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.Autopilot.BashDoors.Desc: Break through locked or hostile doors that block the way to a target.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.Autopilot.KeepDistance.De: Ranged fighters back away from melee attackers that get too close.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.Autopilot.FallBackInjured: When badly hurt, retreat from enemies pressing the attack, then keep fighting carefully from cover at range instead of charging.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.Autopilot.AvoidBlasts.Des: Run clear of ticking explosives and incoming blasts.
Cast the abilities this pawn has marked for autocast. The marks say which abilities; this says whether. When off, the marks are kept but ignored.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.Core.Settings.EnableComba: Allow drafted pawns to fight on their own. Adds combat and hunting policies and new gizmos to drafted pawns. Turning this off removes the gizmos and stops the automation.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.Core.Settings.UndraftClea: Undrafting turns off search and destroy and hunt animals
Unchecks Search and destroy and Hunt animals whenever a pawn is undrafted.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.Autopilot.PolicyTip: Create and manage templates for controlling how drafted pawns fight on their own. Assign policies from the Assign, Animals, or Mechs tab; vehicles carry a combat policy gizmo instead.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.Autopilot.Policy.None.Tip: No combat policy. The combat autopilot is fully off for this pawn: no search and destroy, no engage orders, no automatic casting. Hunting animals and patrolling are separate and keep working.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.Autopilot.HuntPolicyTip: Create and manage templates for controlling which animals drafted pawns may hunt: an allowed-species list, a revenge chance range, and venerated-animal protection. Hunting itself is switched on per pawn with the Hunt animals gizmo. While drafted, these rules take priority over hunting marks.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.Autopilot.HuntPolicyIsDef: The default hunting policy cannot be deleted.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.Autopilot.HuntRevengeRang: Only animals whose revenge chance on harm falls inside this range may be hunted.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.Autopilot.HuntSpareVenera: Never hunt animals the pawn's ideoligion venerates.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.Autopilot.SummaryNothing: Enables nothing. The pawn holds position and fires at will.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.Autopilot.Report.FleeingB: running clear of a blast from {0}.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.Autopilot.Report.VehicleA: driving to engage the nearest hostile.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.Autopilot.EngageOption.Ti: Attack this target until it is down. Enemies attacking on the way are fought off first.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.Autopilot.AttackDesignato: Mark targets for search-and-destroy pawns to attack first. Area sweeps mark hostiles only; shift adds factionless creatures, control and shift adds everyone.
